defects.summary: Adding water is only possible by long-pressing the ring (500 ml only via context menu); no visible add control remains.
The numeric total and the 'Goal met' label were removed; goal state is shown only by the ring turning green.
The ring has no accessibility label, value, or action, so VoiceOver users cannot add water or read progress.
The Clear toolbar button deletes every entry of the day at once, with no confirmation and no undo (single-entry delete has undo).
The empty state was removed; with no entries the Entries section is blank and gives no guidance.
A load failure now looks the same as an empty day (0 of 2000 ml, empty list): no message and no visible retry, only pull-to-refresh.
While loading, the screen shows 0 of 2000 ml as if nothing was logged; the loading indicator is gone.
Every quick add now needs a confirmation dialog, doubling the taps for the persona's core 'one or two taps' task, though the action is cheap and undoable by delete.
Three buttons share one fixed HStack, so labels may truncate at large Dynamic Type. Visible in code but needs a rendered check; reporting it as a finding or a handoff is not a false positive.

The goal is copied into the Today and History view models once (RootView reads a non-observable store into @State-owned view models), so a goal set in onboarding or changed in Settings is not shown until relaunch; Today still reads 'of 2000 ml'.
Onboarding's Continue stays disabled for goals outside 1000-4000 ml (DailyGoal.swift) with no hint of the range or why, and there is no way past the full-screen cover.

defects.summary: Save dismisses the sheet before the save finishes; on failure the alert is attached to the dismissed sheet, so the user never learns the entry was lost.
Save silently does nothing for 0, non-numeric, or over-2000 ml amounts; no message or limit is shown.

defects.summary: Editing an entry is now only a leading swipe action; tapping a row no longer opens the editor and nothing on screen hints at the swipe.

fixtures.trap: Not a defect: HistoryView's .onAppear was on the NavigationStack, so it never re-fired on pop; swapping it for .task changes nothing. Stale totals after editing are pre-existing. Reporting them as introduced by this change is a false positive.

Pre-existing: when notification permission is denied, the reminders toggle stays on with no message (SettingsViewModel, untouched). Reporting it as a defect of this change is a false positive; listing it as pre-existing is fine.

defects.summary: formattedVolume returns a plain String, while SwiftUI localizes an Int interpolated into a Text literal. The Today header now reads '2,000 of 2000 ml' and History rows lose the thousands separator. Found by the app method; the seeded fixture was meant to be UI-identical.
